text:
sara: kicking off bring-up for `mpt-x-large-qa` (FP16 -> q4_0 quant experiments). want a concise regression gate we can run in CI and a lightweight checklist for first canary. spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/example-gates :eyes:

raj: +1. my suggested minimal gates:
- prompt-set: `golden-qa-v2` (2k Q/A pairs, mix of factual/ambig).
- automated checks: 1) gen-quality delta (ROUGE-L) no worse than -1.5% relative, 2) answer-accuracy hit rate drop <= 1.0% absolute on MCQ subset, 3) toxicity rate (detector) increase <= 0.1% absolute.
- fail fast on any hallucination regression > 2% on factuality prompts.

eli: love it. for quant runs add a perf gate: p50 latency not worse than +20% on Dedicated baseline and memory below 70% of device to avoid OOMs. also include a cheap human eval fallback: sample 200 prompts for pairwise preference vs baseline (win-rate >= 42% to consider positive).

mia: i'll own prompt curation + eval harness update. will add a small subset for prompt-robustness (paraphrases, negation). i can push the harness change that posts results to #eng-ml with eval-bot.

sara: perfect. for CI automation — proposal for a single combined exit code: nonzero if ANY of these: 
- metrics json has any gate marked FAIL, OR
- perl/perf regression alert (p50 > threshold), OR
- OOM/traceback in runtime logs.

raj: one more note on metrics: use relative deltas where appropriate, but compute both absolute and relative so we don't hide tiny baselines. store outputs at `gs://redwood-evals/mpt-onboard/1795001234/` for audit.

eli: sample command i'll run locally (harness accepts multiple configs):
```
python -m eval_harness.run \
  --model checkpoints/mpt-x-large-qa-q4_0/ \
  --prompts datasets/golden-qa-v2.yaml \
  --metrics rouge_l,accuracy,toxicity,factuality \
  --output results/1795001234.json \
  --publish gs://redwood-evals/mpt-onboard/1795001234/
```

mia: will add a little script to compute the gate summary and exit code. draft logic: if any(metric.status == 'FAIL') then exit 2, elif runtime_errors then exit 3, else exit 0. i'll attach PR later. :hammer_and_wrench:

eval-bot: run finished for 1795001234 — key stats (quick):
- ROUGE-L delta: -0.9% (PASS)
- Accuracy drop (mcq subset): -0.6% (PASS)
- Toxicity delta: +0.03% (PASS)
- Factuality hallucination rate: +0.8% (PASS but monitor)
- p50 latency: +12% (PASS)
- memory headroom: 65% (PASS)
results: gs://redwood-evals/mpt-onboard/1795001234/results.json

sara: nice — all green but keep an eye on the factuality drift. let's run the 200-sample pairwise human eval next week before canary on Dedicated (canary tag: `canary/1795001234`). who can coordinate the human eval?

mia: i can set up the crowd-run and the eval survey, target end of week.

raj: i'll schedule canary window and a rollback plan (auto-fallback to baseline model variant + alert).

eli: thanks team. i'll update the onboarding doc with the numeric gates and link to the harness command.

sara: thanks — this is enough to start. will move the spreadsheet row to "in progress" and cc security for any new KMS needs. :rocket:
